narrative: SmartAccount sandboxes decouple borrower leverage from lending pool solvency. 14 smart contracts isolate each execution sandbox, preventing cross-account risk contagion while routing to Blend, Soroswap, and Aquarius.
headline: Isolated Sandboxes. Zero Contagion.
subhead: Monolithic lending pools socialize bad debt. Vanna confines up to 10x leverage to dedicated on-chain SmartAccounts on Stellar Soroban.
